content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Multiple GPU alerts: gpu.ecc.errors > 10/min across rack-12 nodes (gnode-120, gnode-121). Severity: P1. Related: gpu.vram.oom_spike on gnode-121. Alert group: gpu-health-rack-12. https://alerts.redwood/internal/alert/1968001111

Priya: i'm taking this. seeing ECC counter jumps on 120/121 and a few thermal spikes. starting triage in #incident-gpu-rack12. marco, you free?

Marco: on it. I see gnode-121 OOMs on small batch embeddings jobs -> autoscaled replicas failed and retried. Support-Bot, any customer tickets?

Support-Bot: Ticket cluster: 4 tickets in last 12m: EMB-2045 (high-p95), EMB-2047 (retries), DEV-551 (internal test failure). Affected namespaces: embeddings-prod, internal-bench.

SRE-Lead: escalate plan: 1) stop cascading evictions (we're getting alert storms), 2) cordon worst nodes, 3) throttle new sched placements to rack-12, 4) collect diag. Also we need to address alert noise so on-call isn't flooded.

ops-bot: executing mitigations:
```
# cordon high-error node
kubectl cordon gnode-121
# set a temporary placement constraint to avoid rack-12
kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"avoid_racks":"rack-12:60m"}}'
```

Marco: cordon did reduce immediate placements. But eviction storm already started from autoscaler. I'm scaling down the autoscaler window for embeddings-prod to reduce churn.

Priya: collecting telemetry bundle and nvidia logs:
```
/scripts/collect_gpu_ring.sh --nodes gnode-120,gnode-121 --out /tmp/gpu-bundle-1968001111.tar.gz
sha256sum /tmp/gpu-bundle-1968001111.tar.gz
```

infra-bot: diag bundle uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/diag/gpu-bundle-1968001111.tar.gz

Marco: thermal profile: rack-12 ambient rose ~3C in last 30m, cooling unit CU-9 reported a transient drop in coolant flow at 03:12 UTC. Could be correlated. ECC errors spike when temps go >73C.

SRE-Lead: important: we keep getting repeated ECC alerts for the same nodes which trigger pagers repeatedly. propose two changes: 1) increase evaluation window to 5m and require sustained rate, 2) group by rack+node and add a suppress-if-reopened cooldown to avoid duplicates. Priya please prepare an alert patch and runbook note.

Priya: drafting patch and will run in staging first. Proposed rule snippet: 
```yaml
- alert: GPU_ECC_RackFlood
  expr: sum by(node)(increase(gpu_ecc_count[5m])) > 30
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
    team: infra
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/gpu-ecc
    affected_scope: "{{ $labels.node }}"
```
Also adding a suppression label to auto-silence identical-rule pages for 20m after an acknowledgement.

Marco: additionally adding a VRAM saturation alert that triggers before OOMs: detect sudden delta in vram free bytes across pods on a node. Proposed: delta over 1m > 40% and free < 15%.

SRE-Lead: good. Also add a dashboard tile that shows "alert flapping by node" to quickly spot noisy nodes. Create a short-lived maintenance window for rack-12 while we assess.

ops-bot: maintenance window created: rack-12: 45m. Affects scheduling, alerts suppressed for non-critical categories.

Support-Bot: updated customer-facing status page: "We are investigating elevated GPU error rates in one rack which may affect embeddings latency for some customers. Engineering working on mitigation." Link: https://status.redwood/incident/1968001111

Priya: pushed alert change to staging and running a canary. I'll add alert annotation to include impacted namespaces by correlating pod labels during evaluation (helps support).

Marco: after cordon + autoscaler tuning, embeddings retries dropped 80%. OOM spike on gnode-121 subsided after evict+reschedule. Thermal trending down slowly; ECC counts plateaued.

SRE-Lead: next steps (post-incident):
- Hardware swap request for gnode-121 (possible GPU DIM ECC flakiness). Marco to open ticket with HW team.
- Cooling unit CU-9 inspection: infra ops to check coolant loop and fans.
- Long-term: adjust scheduler packing heuristics to avoid overconsolidation in racks with single cooling unit.
- Alerts: Priya to publish PR with dampening defaults and example annotation for "affected_customers".
- Dashboards: add ECC heatmap by rack, VRAM delta alert panel, and alert flap metric.

Priya: created infra PR: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/412 and Dashboard ticket DASH-1301 with mocks: https://dashboards.redwood/d/xyz/gpu-ops?panelId=4

Marco: opened hardware ticket HW-812 for gnode-121 swap. Added logs and diag bundle.

Support-Bot: all affected tickets updated. Customers notified when we confirmed degradation resolved.

SRE-Lead: handoff: I'll be oncall for the next 20m to monitor. @Marco then @NightOps. Please paste final confirmations here once PRs merge and HW accepts swap.

Priya: final notes: temporary alert suppressions applied only to ECC flood rule group and auto-revert after maintenance window. Runbook updated with guidance: prefer node cordon+drain over immediate power-cycle unless OOM persists. PR link included in thread.

Marco: observed residual single-digit ECC blips but not sustained. We'll keep node cordoned until HW swap scheduled.

incident-bot: Incident update: reduced to monitoring. Duration so far: 00:05:54. Auto-close disabled while maintenance open.

SRE-Lead: thanks team. Good catch on the cooling correlation. We'll follow up in postmortem with timeline and decision log. Closing the loop in 2 days after HW verification. :thumbsup:

Priya: adding synthetic CI test to run weekly that stresses a pinned device and validates ECC counters remain flat under normal load. Will link test PR when ready.

Marco: putting a scheduler tweak RFC on backlog to add rack-level cooling-awareness.

Support-Bot: customers marked incidents resolved in tickets. Will reopen if further regressions.

SRE-Lead: thread will be included in incident tracking. End of thread for now
